name: Radiance Field Loss
definition: A loss function that treats surface candidates as binary choices (exist or not) rather than volumetric opacities, minimizing the weighted sum of color losses for the candidate and background surfaces to promote distinct surface geometry.
summary: Radiance Field Loss is a differentiable optimization objective that blends color losses rather than opacities to force binary surface selection, avoiding the blended artifacts of standard volumetric alpha-compositing.
